get.summary: Retrieve pre-processed file metadata (project scope, v2)
get.description: Returns pre-processed document metadata in a v2 envelope with allowed_actions from the authenticated user's tool roles.

parameters.name: no_previews
parameters.description: When true, omit image previews in the response

x-code-samples.title: Node.js
Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPConnection("localhost:8080")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v2.0/companies/%7Bcompany_id%7D/projects/%7Bproject_id%7D/file_processors/preprocess/%7Bitem_type%7D/%7Bitem_id%7D?attachment_id=SOME_STRING_VALUE&no_previews=SOME_BOOLEAN_VALUE")

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

post.summary: Trigger pre-processing for a file (project scope, v2)
post.description: Creates a process to pre-process the document and upload to storage. Response uses the v2 data envelope; no permissions object on POST.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the item to pre-process

parameters.name: replace_existing
parameters.description: When true, replace any existing pre-processed artifacts

parameters.name: optimize
parameters.description: When true, request optimization passes where supported
